questions.question: How should I store the asafoetida powder to preserve the aroma?
questions.answer: Keep in the airtight container provided, away from direct moisture and sunlight. Do not keep open next to other spices as its aroma is very potent.

questions.question: How much powder is recommended per serving of sambar or dal?
questions.answer: A pinch (approx. 1/8 to 1/4 teaspoon) tempered in hot ghee or sesame oil is sufficient for 4-6 servings.

questions.question: Does this contain any traces of wheat or gluten-bearing starches?
questions.answer: No. Our gluten-free asafoetida is formulated using non-gluten starches and processed on dedicated, tested equipment.
